newer_changes_search: Web search (2026-10-26): the Union Cabinet decision of 14 Oct 2026 (PIB 2323264) renamed NSAP and IGNDPS (now Pradhan Mantri Divyangjan Pension Yojana), lowered the disability threshold from 80% to 40%, set the minimum age to 'since birth' and the rate to Rs 375 (0-79) / Rs 625 (80+). The scheme file already reflects this. I found no evidence that the revised guidelines have been issued yet; the Cabinet said within three months, so mid-January 2027 at the latest.

findings.note: The 40% threshold (and no minimum age) comes from a Cabinet decision whose guidelines are not yet issued. Until then, offices may still apply the 2014 guideline (18+, 80%, Rs 300), so the 40-79% and child cases are 'likely relevant' on a decision that is not yet in force. The content says this clearly, confidence is 'guidance' and reverify_days is 30. That is acceptable.
findings.suggestion: Re-check within 30 days. When the revised guidelines appear, cite them as a 'guideline' source and raise confidence. Consider 'uncertain' on benchmark_disability until then, so the label shows the doubt.

findings.note: Both are marked mandatory and cited to the NSAP guidelines, but §5.2.12 says 'no beneficiary is denied his or her entitlements for the reason that she has no bank / Post Office account and/or Aadhaar number'.
findings.suggestion: Set mandatory: false for aadhaar and bank_account.

findings.note: is_bpl asks about a BPL/Antyodaya card, but guideline §3.1.3 says an eligible person whose name is not on the BPL list 'should not be left out'. A confident 'not eligible' for someone without a card is stricter than the source. how_to_apply mentions this, but the result does not.
findings.suggestion: Consider confidence 'uncertain' on the bpl rule, so a 'no' shows 'check with the office' rather than 'not eligible'. Apply the same choice to all NSAP schemes.

findings.note: The 2014 MoRD guideline is a copy hosted on ssepd.odisha.gov.in (an official state site), not on nsap.dord.gov.in. It is official and its text is plainly the central guideline.
findings.suggestion: Prefer the copy on nsap.dord.gov.in if one can be fetched.
